findings.finding: The Q3 2026 results release (6-K, Exhibit 99.1) was accepted on EDGAR at 2026-11-12 06:05:21 ET, before today's open, not after the close. The stock traded it all session: +5.8% at the 13:09 ET seal vs the 155.94 prior close, range 149.77-169.00, on 321,666 shares vs a 164,199 20-day average. Window entry at today's close is therefore post-reaction, after a +15.3% five-day run. Q2 by contrast was accepted at 21:50 ET on 2026-08-12 and the next session moved -7.07%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last confirmed results print, Q2 (6-K accepted 2026-08-12 21:50 ET), moved -7.07% the next session (baseline row 2026-08-12 amc). The baseline's other rows include non-results 6-Ks (cadence flagged implausible), so there is no clean history of a day-two move after an already-absorbed release.
findings.why_not_priced: It IS priced: that is the point. A judge assuming the print lands after the close would expect a full earnings-sized move inside the window. If the market had not seen the release, today's tape would be flat on normal volume, not +6% on 2x volume with a 19-point range. The only residual is fade or continuation of today's move plus the webcast Q&A. That is an inference, sized small.
findings.independence: Today's daily bar, Yahoo chart API (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/BLTE?range=1mo&interval=1d): a different source from EDGAR that is consistent with an intraday reaction. The Q2 6-K acceptance time (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1889109/000110465926095218/0001104659-26-095218-index.html, 2026-08-12 21:50 ET) shows the timing changed this quarter.

findings.finding: The Q3 release states that the FDA will not hold an advisory committee meeting for the tinlarebant STGD1 NDA (PDUFA 2027-02-12). That is firmer than the Q2 call, where management said it did 'not currently believe' one was planned and that the FDA could still convene one.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Regulatory de-risking news has been bought on this name: the Priority Review and PDUFA date (Aug 2026) and the uplisting (2026-10-19, +3.19%). No prior AdCom-specific disclosure to compare.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: public since 06:05 ET and plausibly part of today's +6%. The residual is that the webcast Q&A may elaborate (for example a formal FDA communication) and that sell-side notes reiterating this land overnight, inside the window. If it were fully priced and unimportant, today's rally would not have happened on a release whose numbers were in line.
findings.independence: Earlier company statements pointing the same way: the Q2 call ('does not currently believe' an AdCom is planned) and a Wells Fargo conference summary ('not anticipated') (https://quartr.com/events/belite-bio-inc-blte-wells-fargo-21st-annual-healthcare-conference_F353QL0Y). Both are company-sourced.

findings.finding: Q3 numbers landed on the bar. GAAP net loss $30.3M, GAAP EPS -$0.75 per ordinary share vs a -$0.76 single-source consensus. Cash $271.3M plus $502.7M of US Treasuries, about $774M of liquidity vs about $780M at 30 June, so net burn was roughly $6M after $6.7M of interest income. No new financing.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Pre-revenue biotech, so EPS is not the traded line. Q2's widened loss (-$28.4M) was followed by -7.07%, but that move came with no new regulatory catalyst and is not attributable to the EPS line.
findings.why_not_priced: Priced: public pre-market and in line. Filed so that judges see the quarter holds no surprise and the bar is single-sourced.
findings.independence: Q2 liquidity of $779.9M (RTTNews 2026-08-13, https://www.rttnews.com/3679979/belite-bio-q2-net-loss-widens-fda-sets-pdufa-date-for-tinlarebant-in-february-2027.aspx) for the cash walk. The bar has one source.

findings.finding: SG&A rose to $21.4M GAAP ($16.3M non-GAAP) from $16.7M in Q2 and $12.7M a year earlier, as US pre-launch build-out ramps ahead of the February 2027 PDUFA. The company has signposted $200-250M of commercialization spend.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None isolable. Q2's SG&A jump to $16.7M accompanied a -7.07% session, but with no separable cause.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced and inside the signposted launch budget. A residual exists only if the webcast frames a higher 2027 cost base.
findings.independence: Commercialization spend of about $200-250M and about $150M of three-year R&D (Simply Wall St via Webull, 2026-10-01, https://www.webull.com/news/15673411591619584).

findings.finding: The release gives NO timing for the PHOENIX (GA, 530 subjects) interim analysis, while a Q2 call summary placed it in Q1 2027. Any timing, design or statistical-hurdle detail given or withheld on tonight's webcast is a two-sided risk inside the window. GA is the larger market and the bulk of upside beyond STGD1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior PHOENIX timing change to compare. The DRAGON topline (late 2025) was the name's largest catalyst.
findings.why_not_priced: Unknown until the call. The release's silence means the market has no update. If a slip or pull-forward were already expected, the release would have said so and today's tape would show it.
findings.independence: Q3 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1889109/000110465926125573/tm2629321d1_ex99-1.htm) says only that the company 'expects to conduct an interim analysis'. Same company, different document.

findings.finding: Ex-US filings advanced: a J-NDA was submitted to Japan's MHLW in September 2026 under Sakigake (management has said approval could come about 3 months after FDA), and MAAs were submitted in October 2026 in the UK, Singapore and Switzerland via the Access Consortium. DRAGON II enrollment is complete at 73 subjects, with no readout date.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Incremental regulatory filings have produced small positive sessions (the uplisting 6-K, 2026-10-19: +3.19%).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced, since the September J-NDA was likely disclosed earlier (6-K 2026-09-08). The Access Consortium MAAs may be first disclosed here, but they are public since 06:05 ET.
findings.independence: Japan timing per the Q2 materials (search summary of company statements). The 6-K list on EDGAR (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001889109&type=6-K) shows 6-Ks on 2026-09-08 and 2026-10-19.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with. The +15% five-day run-up and today's +6% on the already-public release mean the window starts after the reaction, which pulls the expected window move toward zero and slightly toward a fade. Moderate short interest (about 3% of shares, 7 days to cover) limits that fade.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar single-sourced): kept every finding small and said so in bar; no size above 0.4 in magnitude.
Rule 6 (inside what was signposted): SG&A ramp moved from -0.2 to -0.1 because it sits inside the signposted $200-250M commercialization budget.
Rule 5 and core table (an inference on positioning): the already-reacted fade finding shrank from -0.5 to -0.4. Rule 7: short interest checked and moderate.
Asking-what-was-missed pessimism: p_up moved from 48 to 49. The ex-US filings finding was cut from +0.2 to +0.1 as mostly disclosed earlier.

History lesson (wrong events in an FPI reaction history): used only the confirmed Q2 results print (-7.07%) as a reaction reference and cut abs_move from 3.0 to 2.5, because the release was absorbed before the window.
